Proof 1: Maximum Likelihood: theta_hat = argmax L(theta) = argmax prod f(x_i; theta)

Statement: Maximum Likelihood: theta_hat = argmax L(theta) = argmax prod f(x_i; theta)

Hypotheses: parametric model f(x;theta), iid sample x_1,...,x_n

Conclusion: MLE estimator theta_hat

Definitions: MLE, likelihood, estimation
